messages:
rachel s: Urgent  my husband landed in the US this morning for a planned visit but had an acute appendix issue and the ER wants to bill him as self-pay. He was added to my benefits in Workday yesterday but the hospital says enrollment isn't visible. Can People Ops confirm coverage retroactively so they don't hold him?

omar: Sorry to hear that. Two quick things: 1) If his dependent enrollment was submitted within 30 days of the event we can request a retroactive effective date to include the ER visit. 2) We need a copy of the Workday confirmation screenshot + their passport or marriage certificate to verify spousal relationship. Can you DM those now?

rachel s: DM sent  Workday timestamped confirmation + marriage cert photo. Hospital billing keeps asking for a member ID on official letterhead. They're refusing to proceed without proof.

people-ops-bot: Automated note: Retroactive dependent coverage requests follow carrier rules. People Ops will submit a carrier appeal for retroactive enrollment if docs provided within standard window. Estimated carrier response time: 5-7 business days. For emergent visits we can issue a provider verification letter to hospital pending carrier decision.

trina: I can produce a provisional employer letter on letterhead that includes your member ID and indicates a dependent enrollment was submitted on 2026-03-19 and requested retroactivity to 2026-03-18 due to emergency. Do you want us to fax it to the hospital billing fax or email the admitting office? Fax usually operates faster.

rachel s: Fax them please  fax is +1-212-555-0199. They said if we can include the carrier group number and policyholder name that helps expedite admittance.

benefits-ops: Drafting provisional letter: 

"Redwood Inference Benefits Office
Re: Verification of Coverage (Provisional) for Member: Rachel Stone (EmpID R-20234)
Dependent: Ahmed Stone (DOB: 1992-07-08)
Plan: Redwood Core PPO (Group 879453)
Notice: Dependent enrollment submitted 2026-03-19. Requesting retroactive effective date 2026-03-18 due to emergent hospitalization. This letter is provisional verification while carrier reviews retroactive enrollment request. Please accept for billing and admission purposes.
"

benefits-ops: Faxed to +1-212-555-0199 and emailed admissions@manhattan-er.example. Attached Workday confirmation screenshot. Ticket #PO-8420 created.

omar: Hospital billing confirmed receipt and allowed admittance without full payment; they logged a self-pay hold pending carrier decision. Good sign. After carrier decision, if claim was paid and they billed patient, we will submit claim appeal and coordinate refund.

rachel s: Thank you!! Any chance of an emergency advance to cover copay today if they request it?

people-ops-bot: Emergency advance policy: available for emergent inpatient/ER services when dependent enrollment pending. To request, submit Advance Request form via portal or email urgent-benefits@redwood.ai with subject "Advance Request - PO-8420". Target processing: 24-48 hours. Include hospital invoice and provisional letter.

trina: I submitted the carrier retroactive enrollment request just now and attached the docs. If carrier rejects retroactivity we will file an exception appeal citing emergency admission and Workday confirmation. Keep all receipts and hospital itemized bills.

benefits-ops: Logged follow-up tasks: 1) Monitor carrier appeal 2) If claim paid to patient, initiate refund process 3) Order replacement physical ID card showing dependent once carrier confirms. Closing note added to ticket PO-8420.

rachel s: Appreciate the speed. Husband is stable and they let him stay without upfront payment. I'll follow up with hospital statements and keep you posted. :heart:
